title: Tshingwana e Ikanne ka Mafube
intro: Mo diureng tse di didimetseng pele ga letsatsi le tlhaba, go ne ga dirwa leano mo sephiring. Boswa jo bo atlegileng bo ne bo siametse thobo, le fa go ntse jalo go ne ga bopiwa tshwetso ya go boloka leungo lengwe le lengwe kgakala le ba ba tlhokang. Fa go nna mo mosong, sengwe le sengwe se ne se tla lebega se sa tlwaelega, mme thuto e ne e tla gabiwa mo dikaleng tse di ntshofaditsweng tsa botlhe ba ba akanyang.
clues: Re ne ra rua tshingwana e e neng e atlega mme ra ikana gore re tla roba maungo otlhe a yone.
Re ne ra ikana gore re tla tswa go sa le phakela fa bahumanegi ba ba neng ba kopa kabelo ya bone ba santse ba robetse.
Re ne ra kgaphela kwa thoko pharologano epe mo maikanong a rona mme ra thibela tshwanelo ya batlhoki re sa bolele fa Allah a rata.
Re ne ra tswa re sebasebana gore re se ka ra letlelela ope yo o humanegileng go tsena mo tshingwaneng ya rona letsatsi leo.
Re ne re ipona re kgona go phutha sengwe le sengwe ka botlalo le go thibela motlhotlhomisi ope go tsaya karolo.
Re ne ra tsoga go fitlhela tshingwana ya rona e senyegile bosigo, e ntshofetse jaaka e kete e kotutswe, mme ra re re amogilwe e bile re ikwatlhaile.

identity.label: Ke Mang?
options: Batsala ba Mosele
Balekane ba Tshingwana
Barongwa ba Motse mo Surah Ya-Sin
Batho ba Tlou
Batlhokomedi ba Molelo wa Dihele

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Go ntsha kgomo setlhabelo go rarabolola kgotlhang ya polao
Go gwetlha moporofeti gore a folose matlapa go tswa kwa loaping
Go loga leano la go roba ka mahube fa o ntse o ganela bahumanegi kabelo ya bone
Go tlola Sabata ka go tlhoma matloa a go tshwara ditlhapi
Go aga letamo go laola metsi a morwalela go dira kgwebo
trial.answer: Go loga leano la go roba ka mahube fa o ntse o ganela bahumanegi kabelo ya bone

location.label: Elemente ya Botlhokwa
options: Mokgatšha o o boitshepo wa Tuwa kwa molelo o neng wa bonwa teng
Tshingwana ya maungo e e ageletsweng ka lobota e e tla robiwang mo mosong
Bodilo jwa ntlo ya segosi jo bo nang le seipone bo tsewa e le metsi
Areka ya logong e e neng ya agiwa ka taelo ya Modimo
Lobota lwa tshipi lo lo agilweng fa gare ga dithaba tse pedi
location.answer: Tshingwana ya maungo e e ageletsweng ka lobota e e tla robiwang mo mosong

outcome.label: Botso
options: Re ne ra fetolwa ditshwene ka ntlha ya go tlola molao wa Sabata
Re robetse mo logageng dingwaga di le makgolo a mararo le borobongwe
Re ne ra mediwa ke lefatshe ka matlotlo a boikgantsho
Tshingwana ya rona e ne ya senngwa ka bosigo bo le bongwe mme ya sala e le ntsho jaaka bosigo
Re ne ra nwela mo lewatleng re ntse re latelela badumedi .
outcome.answer: Tshingwana ya rona e ne ya senngwa ka bosigo bo le bongwe mme ya sala e le ntsho jaaka bosigo

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
